```mjs title=main.mjs
import { __webpack_require__ } from "./runtime.mjs";

import { createRequire as __rspack_createRequire } from "node:module";
const __rspack_createRequire_require = __rspack_createRequire(import.meta.url);
__webpack_require__.add({
"./dep.js"
/*!****************!*\
  !*** ./dep.js ***!
  \****************/
(module) {
module.exports = "dep";


},
});
// node:module
const external_node_module_namespaceObject = __rspack_createRequire_require("node:module");
// ./only-require.js


const only_require_require = /* createRequire() */ undefined;

const required = __webpack_require__(/*! ./dep.js */ "./dep.js");

// ./with-resolve.js


const with_resolve_require = /* createRequire() */ undefined;

const resolved = /*require.resolve*/(/*! ./dep.js */ "./dep.js");

// ./with-unknown-member.js


const with_unknown_member_require = __rspack_createRequire(import.meta.url);

const unknownMember = with_unknown_member_require.a;

// ./mixed-parsed-and-preserved.js


const mixed_parsed_and_preserved_require = __rspack_createRequire(import.meta.url);

const mixedRequired = __webpack_require__(/*! ./dep.js */ "./dep.js");
const mixedResolved = /*require.resolve*/(/*! ./dep.js */ "./dep.js");
const mixedUnknownMember = mixed_parsed_and_preserved_require.a;

// ./with-value-escape.js


const with_value_escape_require = __rspack_createRequire(import.meta.url);
const escapedRequire = with_value_escape_require;

const escapedRequireType = typeof escapedRequire;

// ./index.js








it("preserves created require only for unhandled usages across modules", () => {
	expect(required).toBe("dep");
	expect(resolved).toBe("./dep.js");
	expect(unknownMember).toBe(undefined);
	expect(mixedRequired).toBe("dep");
	expect(mixedResolved).toBe("./dep.js");
	expect(mixedUnknownMember).toBe(undefined);
	expect(escapedRequireType).toBe("function");
});

export { escapedRequireType, mixedRequired, mixedResolved, mixedUnknownMember, required, resolved, unknownMember };

```

```mjs title=runtime.mjs

var __webpack_modules__ = {};
// The module cache
var __webpack_module_cache__ = {};
// The require function
function __webpack_require__(moduleId) {
// Check if module is in cache
var cachedModule = __webpack_module_cache__[moduleId];
if (cachedModule !== undefined) {
return cachedModule.exports;
}
// Create a new module (and put it into the cache)
var module = (__webpack_module_cache__[moduleId] = {
exports: {}
});
// Execute the module function
__webpack_modules__[moduleId](module, module.exports, __webpack_require__);

// Return the exports of the module
return module.exports;
}
// expose the modules object (__webpack_modules__)
__webpack_require__.m = __webpack_modules__;

// webpack/runtime/esm_register_module
(() => {
__webpack_require__.add = function registerModules(modules) { Object.assign(__webpack_require__.m, modules) }

})();

export { __webpack_require__ };

```
